combinations.magnitude: complete antiallodynic activity, higher than full doses of each inhibitor (SAHA 10 µg, i-BET762 25 µg)
combinations.evidence_quote: Co-administration of partially effective doses of the reference drugs (i-BET762 10 µg, SAHA 3 µg) increased both thermal (Fig. 5A) and mechanical (Fig. 5D) pain threshold reaching a complete antiallodynic activity with higher efficacy than full effective doses of each inhibitor (i-BET762 25 µg, SAHA 10 µg) (Fig. 5A, D).
